problems.title: Order of the reaction of hydrogen with nitric oxide
problems.problem:
Question 9 (Paper 1, Section 3: non-negative integer answer).

Consider the following reaction,

$$\ce{2H2(g) + 2NO(g) -> N2(g) + 2H2O(g)}$$

which follows the mechanism given below:

$$\begin{array}{ll} \ce{2NO(g)} \underset{k_{-1}}{\overset{k_1}{\rightleftharpoons}} \ce{N2O2(g)} & \text{(fast equlibrium)} \\ \ce{N2O2(g) + H2(g)} \overset{k_2}{\longrightarrow} \ce{N2O(g) + H2O(g)} & \text{(slow reaction)} \\ \ce{N2O(g) + H2(g)} \overset{k_3}{\longrightarrow} \ce{N2(g) + H2O(g)} & \text{(fast reaction)} \end{array}$$
